description: Convert a natural-language query into machine intent, a bounded Evidence Pack, and one immutable x402 job with a fresh quote pointer. Use this when an agent needs to turn a what-would-I-Google question into a priced, quotable evidence job before any payment. Returns the immutable job_id plus the public job summary; on invalid input returns a structured input_rejected error instead of a job. Creates one server-side job record per call (a side effect) but never spends or moves funds. For example, asking whether a token contract is safe becomes an intent-scored Evidence Pack with fresh PAYMENT-REQUIRED terms.

query.description: The natural-language question to compile into intent and an Evidence Pack (1-60000 chars).

name: aftersearch_resolve

outputSchema.description: Canonical REST response envelope, or a local/transport rejection. Upstream data remains in body and is defined by the live capability schema.

body.description: Unmodified upstream JSON, or bounded response text. Consult that capability's live schema.

charged.description: Present on local/transport failures; these do not establish an upstream charge.

ok.description: Whether the upstream HTTP status is 2xx; not settlement proof.

payment_required.description: Observed PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a challenge does not prove payment.

payment_response.description: Observed PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Assess it together with accepted delivery.

status_code.description: Observed upstream HTTP status, or null when no response was obtained.

title: Aftersearch Resolve
